hl: there[’']s something wrong with|there is something wrong with

gloss.there’s: there’s = there is: є (there’s something wrong = щось не так)
gloss.with: з (something wrong with = щось не так з)
gloss.the: the: те саме пиво, про яке мова
gloss.by: ким: by a left-handed person = лівшею

clips.line: There’s something wrong with your dress here.
clips.note: Someone notices a problem with a dress: There’s something wrong with your dress here.
clips.noteUa: Хтось помічає, що з сукнею щось не так, і каже: There’s something wrong with your dress.

clips.line: God, Kev, there’s something wrong with the beer.
clips.note: The beer tastes bad, so he says: There’s something wrong with the beer.
clips.noteUa: Пиво дивне на смак (It tastes like poison), тому він каже: There’s something wrong with the beer.

clips.line: Uh, there’s something wrong with this.
clips.note: Monk looks at a note and sees a problem with it.
clips.noteUa: Монк дивиться на записку й бачить, що з нею щось не так.
around: She didn’t say a word to me.
This note was written by a left-handed person.
